rationale: The agent authenticated the user correctly using full name and zip, matched to a single account. It reviewed the user’s orders, identified the pending LA order as eligible, and, upon the user’s request, used the NYC address from the other order. The agent explicitly summarized the exact changes (update shipping address to the NYC address and exchange the Bluetooth speaker to the cheapest available green variant), obtained explicit confirmation before performing any writes, and then executed the address update and item exchange via the tools. The exchange selected the cheapest available green variant and the refund amount and order status reported matched tool outputs. No unsupported claims were made, and actions were confined to the authenticated user’s orders. Minor UX note: the agent restated the full NYC address despite the user’s preference to keep it private, but this does not violate the stated policy and confirmation was still obtained before changes. Overall, the request was completed in line with policy.
